Title: General availability: Azure SDKs support for Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
Azure software development kits (SDKs) now allow you to perform all cluster management operations in Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL. This includes cluster create, PostgreSQL server parameter change, cluster node add, or cluster node compute and storage scaling using the programming language and framework of your choice. All Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL management operations are fully supported in .NET SDK, Go SDK, Java SDK, JavaScript SDK, and Python SDK.

The Azure SDKs are collections of libraries built to make it easier to use Azure services from your language of choice. When you use Azure SDKs, you can perform all cluster management operations programmatically and consistently with management operations for the rest of Azure services.

With this release you can now unify Azure SDKs management for the Azure services you use including Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL.
 

Learn more.
